entities.name: Smokeloader
entities.gloss: A generic modular malware loader used to download and execute secondary malicious payloads.

entities.name: Monero
entities.gloss: A privacy-focused cryptocurrency frequently mined by unauthorized cryptojacking malware.

entities.name: Заявка.js
entities.gloss: A malicious JavaScript file distributed via email to download Smokeloader.

entities.name: crsse.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable file delivering the Smokeloader payload disguised as a legitimate Windows process.

entities.name: 1964.exe
entities.gloss: A local filename used to store the downloaded crsse.exe Smokeloader payload in the temporary directory.

entities.name: csrss.exe
entities.gloss: A critical legitimate Windows operating system process responsible for console windows and process management.

entities.name: explorer.exe
entities.gloss: A legitimate Windows user interface and shell process targeted for process injection by malware.

entities.name: curl.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable containing a Monero cryptocurrency mining program.

entities.name: enterwords.ru
entities.gloss: A domain name used to host and distribute the Smokeloader malware payload.

entities.name: http://enterwords.ru/uadoc/crsse.exe
entities.gloss: A URL hosting the crsse.exe Smokeloader payload for download.

entities.name: parodadoca.ru
entities.gloss: A domain name used to host and distribute a Monero miner executable.

entities.name: http://parodadoca.ru/panel/mr/curl.exe
entities.gloss: A URL used to download the curl.exe Monero miner executable.
